description: Brian turns from the solar system to the larger universe, using time, stellar evolution, gravity and light to explain how the cosmos developed and how human beings fit within it.

s02e01.description: Brian explores the nature of time, entropy and the arrow that carries stars, worlds and life toward an eventual cosmic future.

s02e02.description: Brian asks what humans are made from and traces the elements in our bodies back to the lives and deaths of stars.

s02e03.description: Brian tells the story of gravity, the force that sculpts structures from planets and stars to galaxies and the universe itself.

s02e04.description: Brian explains how light carries information across immense distances and makes it possible to reconstruct the history and origins of the universe.
